name: codex-search-bridge
description: Give any tool-capable model in Codex verified live-web research.

interface.shortDescription: Verified live-web research for external models
interface.longDescription: Let any MCP-capable external model running in Codex call an isolated Codex worker for live search, opened-page evidence, source URLs, publication dates, event dates, conflicts, and explicit uncertainty.
defaultPrompt: Verify today's top AI news with sources and event dates.
Open the relevant pages and mark anything unconfirmed.
Check the latest release and separate publish date from event date.
